prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Build a decade counter that counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10.","S02":"The reset input is active high synchronous, and should reset the counter to 0."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"reset":1},"outputs":{"q":4},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"q","meaning":"Current decade count value 0 through 9, also the 4-bit output q.","update_time":"on posedge clk after evaluating reset and count; sample after the edge has settled","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"sync_reset_high","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 1 implies q = 0 after posedge clk","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous, and should reset the counter to 0","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1},{"reset":1}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":0}]}},{"id":"count_mod_10","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 0 implies q = (previous q + 1) mod 10 after posedge clk","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":0,"spec_quote":"counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1},{"reset":0},{"reset":0},{"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":1},{"q":2},{"q":3}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"the first posedge with reset == 0; normal count applies on that edge"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
